obligations.summary: Each Member State shall designate or establish at least one notifying authority responsible for assessment, designation, notification, and monitoring of conformity assessment bodies, developed in cooperation with other Member States' notifying authorities.
Member States may delegate the assessment and monitoring of conformity assessment bodies to a national accreditation body in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
exceptions: Member States may optionally assign this function to a national accreditation body rather than a dedicated notifying authority.

obligations.summary: Notifying authorities shall be established, organised, and operated in a manner that prevents conflicts of interest with conformity assessment bodies and safeguards the objectivity and impartiality of their activities.

Notifying authorities shall be organised so that decisions on the notification of conformity assessment bodies are taken by persons different from those who carried out the assessment of those bodies.
Notifying authorities shall neither offer nor provide any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform, nor any consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.
Notifying authorities shall safeguard the confidentiality of information obtained in the course of their tasks, in accordance with Article 78.

Notifying authorities shall have an adequate number of competent personnel with the necessary expertise in relevant fields such as information technologies, AI, law, and supervision of fundamental rights for the proper performance of their tasks.
